entries.label: Canonical script alert
entries.notes: Baseline reflected XSS probe — confirms unfiltered tag injection.

entries.label: Break out of attribute then inject script
entries.notes: Closes a quoted attribute and a tag before injecting; common against value="..." sinks.

entries.label: img onerror
entries.notes: Fires on the broken-src error event; useful when <script> is filtered.

entries.label: svg onload
entries.notes: Inline SVG fires onload immediately; passes some tag-name allowlists that miss <svg>.

entries.label: svg onload, no parens (backtick call)
entries.notes: Tagged-template call avoids parentheses — defeats naive '(' blocklists.

entries.label: iframe srcdoc
entries.notes: Inline-document iframe; useful where srcdoc isn't sanitized as HTML.

entries.label: body onload
entries.notes: Fires on document load; occasionally accepted in stored sinks that strip <script>.

entries.label: input autofocus + onfocus
entries.notes: Self-triggers without user interaction via autofocus + onfocus.

entries.label: details ontoggle
entries.notes: Open <details> fires ontoggle on render; survives some HTML filters that miss the tag.

entries.label: Attribute injection — onmouseover
entries.notes: Injects a new attribute inside an existing tag; needs the page to render the surrounding tag for the user to hover.

entries.label: javascript: URI
entries.notes: Place into href/src sinks (a, iframe, form action). Modern browsers block top-frame js: navigation but in-page sinks still trigger.

entries.label: data: URI HTML
entries.notes: data: URI in iframe src; some sandboxes miss this when blocking javascript: only.

entries.label: Case-mixed <ScRiPt>
entries.notes: Defeats case-sensitive 'script' blocklists; HTML parsing is case-insensitive.

entries.label: HTML-entity-encoded angle brackets
entries.notes: Sinks that decode entities before rendering will still execute; tests for double-decoding bugs.

entries.label: Anchor with javascript: entity
entries.notes: Named entity for ':' bypasses filters that match the literal 'javascript:' prefix.

entries.label: Double-URL-encoded payload
entries.notes: Server decodes once (yielding %3C...) and downstream sink decodes again — classic double-decode bug.

entries.label: MathML mtext + script
entries.notes: MathML / SVG foreign-content parser quirks let <script> through some sanitizers.

entries.label: iframe srcdoc with entities
entries.notes: Entities inside srcdoc are decoded by the inner parser — useful when '<' is filtered in the outer context.

entries.label: marquee onstart
entries.notes: Legacy tag still parsed by browsers; onstart fires immediately. Useful where common tags are blocked.

entries.label: Form action javascript:
entries.notes: Submit-button click triggers; tests action-attribute sanitization on form elements.

entries.label: OWASP polyglot
entries.notes: Single string that fires across many contexts (attribute, JS string, comment, tag). Useful for one-shot mass testing.

entries.label: object data:
entries.notes: Embeds an HTML document; passes some filters that block <iframe> by name.
